input.messageText: What should I say to my supervisor about my coworker getting credit for my work?

records.message: Here is a direct, professional draft you can use: "I wanted to touch base briefly regarding [Project/Task]. I noticed [Coworker's Name] was credited for [specific deliverable/result], but I handled [describe your specific contribution, e.g., the research / the initial draft / the analysis]. Moving forward, I want to make sure my direct contributions are clear so we stay aligned on project ownership."
